_comment: v14.2 career endings. Checked at the end of every week in this order; the first whose `when` holds ends the career (academician is decided by the election code and listed here for its text). kinds = the moment kinds the closing screen replays. Fields for `when`: flag (carried career flag), grantFailStreak, lost, collapseWeeks (consecutive weeks with >= 2 collapses), teachAvg4 (teaching KPI mean of the last 4 weeks), trust, consultN. weeks = weeks played; a lost-students exit needs three weeks so a first week cannot end a career.

endings.line_zh: 你站在学部大会的台上。想起的不是答辩，是周二食堂的那碗面。
endings.line_en: On the stage of the academy's assembly, what you remember is not the defence but Tuesday's noodles in the canteen.

endings.line_zh: 非升即走。合同到期那天，你把科普卡一张张收进箱子。走廊尽头，503 的灯还亮着，只是不再是你的。
endings.line_en: Up or out. On the day the contract ended you packed the science cards one by one. Down the corridor the lights of 503 were still on; they were just no longer yours.

endings.line_zh: 你没有成为院士。二十年后，有三个人在自己实验室的门口放了和你一样的那张沙发。
endings.line_en: You never became an academician. Twenty years on, three people put the same sofa you had outside their own labs.

endings.line_zh: 你把 503 的钥匙交给小陈。第一次在周五下午六点准时下班，电梯里没有人认识你。
endings.line_en: You handed the key to 503 to Xiao Chen. For the first time you left at six on a Friday, and nobody in the lift knew who you were.

decisions_title_zh: 把你带到这里的三个决定
decisions_title_en: The three decisions that brought you here
